name: hitotsuzutsu_B
note: B = earshot only. Started from `earshot kit init --preset launch` and edited for this film (a quiet paper-like UI film, not a SaaS launch reel): softer members, lower bed_db on runs, leads capped at about half a frame, Eb major pitches. Every change from the preset is listed in docs/sound-upgrade/CUE_SHEET.md.

land.light.note: cards 1-6 settling in their slots: a CC0 fingertip-on-book recording fitted as code (paper on paper). preset: tap/finger, offset -60, gap 115

pop.note: the three step checks (G4 Bb4 D5 over Cm9) and the counter settling (Eb5). preset bed_db 8.5: lowered for a quiet film

pop.icon.note: the app icon popping in (G5 over the Eb add9 resolution)

click.note: cursor presses (select, the big checkbox, back): as the preset

click.confirm.note: the accent on the big checkbox (G5 over Eb/G). preset bed_db 8.5

whoosh.short.note: the card growing into the detail view and shrinking back (0.6 s easeInOut, fastest at the middle): a paper swipe. preset: whoosh_fast/crisp, bed_db 9

whoosh.hover.note: custom role: the selected card lifting (0.3 s cubic ease-out: fastest at the start); barely there

whoosh.line.note: custom role: the graph baseline stretching into the title rule (inside the stop before the title, so the music bed is nearly silent there)

land.note: the detail view settling (round low thump, after the contact as measured in the preset). preset bed_db 8

tock.note: the card docking back in the list; the tagline dropping into place

tick.note: the counter digit rolling 2 -> 3: two ticks 66 ms apart

swell.note: the green ring window opening onto the weekly view; peak just after it is fully open. One swell in the film. preset: reverse_swell/dark, bed_db 9.5

bell.note: the seven bars rising left to right, one note each over Abmaj9. preset bed_db 7.5: seven in a row, so lower

bell.accent.note: custom role: today's bar settling (the accent at the end of the run, Bb5 over Bb)

drop.note: the title landing on the stop-down: a soft sub hit tuned to the film's root

off.suck: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a lead-in on the hit
off.riser: no build is needed: the swell carries the one section change and the music stops before the title
off.hit: no hard cut in this film; the title gets the soft tuned drop instead
off.snap: no snap zoom or whip cut
off.text: text fragments resolve silently except the title
off.whoosh.long: the swell covers the long move
